title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Lead-Safe Setup and Asbestos Sampling Fees and Year-Built Cutoffs
content:
Regulated-material figures for Fire & Smoke Mitigation jobs: the per-job lead-safe setup fee and the year-built cutoff that ties it to older housing, and the per-job asbestos sampling fee with its own year-built cutoff.

## Items

- Lead-safe setup fee: Lead-safe work practice setup per job, USD.
- RRP year-built cutoff: Housing built before this year triggers lead-safe practices when painted surfaces are disturbed (EPA RRP pre-1978 housing), year.
- Asbestos sampling fee: Pre-demolition asbestos sampling per job, USD.
- Asbestos sampling year cutoff: Buildings built before this year are sampled for asbestos before demolition (company policy), year.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Lead-safe setup, per job (USD) | RRP year-built cutoff | Asbestos sampling, per job (USD) | Asbestos sampling year cutoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 0.00 | 1978 | 0.00 | 1981 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 345.00 | 1978 | 0.00 | 1981 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 345.00 | 1978 | 425.00 | 1981 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 395.00 | 1978 | 425.00 | 1981 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 395.00 | 1978 | 595.00 | 1981 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 0.00 | 1978 | 695.00 | 1981 |

## The two cutoffs side by side

| Year built | Before the RRP cutoff of 1978? | Before the asbestos cutoff of 1981? |
|---|---|---|
| 1977 | yes | yes |
| 1978 | no | yes |
| 1980 | no | yes |
| 1981 | no | no |

"Before" is strict: a building built in 1978 is not before the 1978 cutoff, and a building built in 1981 is not before the 1981 cutoff. The cutoffs are the same on every tier; the fees differ, and the lead-safe setup fee is 0.00 on Smoke Odor Response and Commercial Fire Large Loss, as is the asbestos sampling fee on Smoke Odor Response and Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup.
